title: Biss's matroid Grassmannian gluing error, Mnev's explicit objection, and the author's erratum
scope: A documented failure of inferring contractibility from an open/closed cover and a homotopy equivalence of the intersection inclusion. MG-P001 independently classifies a restricted finite-simplicial vertex-deletion setting.
reuse: Public mathematical facts and error mechanism only; independently written Chinese prompt, proof, realizations and rubric; no copied exercise or proof text.
historical_claim_boundary: The 2009 erratum leaves Theorem 1.1 as a conjecture at that time. Neither the sources nor this adaptation are represented as a disproof; current research status beyond those documents was not audited.
